title: Integrative transcriptomic and single-cell analysis identifies a manganese-associated transcriptional signature and a potential JUN/HBEGF-associated endothelial signature in COPD pulmonary vascular remodeling.
authors: Liu, Ziyi; Nie, Li; Zeng, Huihui
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于转录组和单细胞数据识别COPD中锰相关转录特征及JUN/HBEGF内皮信号，属于纯转录组/单细胞分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a heterogeneous respiratory disease involving airway inflammation, emphysema, and pulmonary vascular remodeling. Manganese exposure has been linked to pulmonary inflammation and oxidative stress, but its molecular association with COPD vascular pathology remains unclear. This study explored a manganese-associated transcriptional signature in COPD and investigated its potential relationship with endothelial cell dysfunction and vascular remodeling. METHODS: Bulk transcriptomic datasets were used to calculate a manganese-related transcriptional score, identify differentially expressed genes, and characterize WGCNA modules. Manganese-COPD-associated genes were obtained by intersecting manganese-related genes, COPD differentially expressed genes, and manganese-associated module genes. Functional enrichment, PPI analysis, machine-learning-based feature selection, diagnostic modeling, and consensus clustering were performed. Single-cell RNA sequencing data were analyzed to characterize HBEGF expression, endothelial subpopulations, CytoTRACE2 scores, pseudotime dynamics, transcription factor activity, cell-cell communication, and NicheNet ligand-target relationships. RESULTS: COPD samples showed significantly higher manganese-related transcriptional scores. A total of 43 manganese-COPD-associated candidate genes were identified and were enriched mainly in pathways related to inflammation, cytokines, immune chemotaxis, and vascular processes. Machine learning identified 14 core diagnostic genes, and the combined model showed good classification performance in the training and validation cohorts. Among these genes, HBEGF showed the highest contribution in the ElasticNet model and was prioritized for downstream analysis. Consensus clustering divided COPD samples into two molecular subtypes with distinct manganese-related scores and functional features. Single-cell analysis suggested that HBEGF was closely associated with endothelial cell alterations, especially venous endothelial cells. Pseudotime and transcription factor analyses suggested a potential JUN/HBEGF regulatory relationship. CellChat and NicheNet analyses further indicated that venous endothelial cell-derived HBEGF may participate in endothelial-smooth muscle cell communication. CONCLUSION: This study identified an elevated manganese-related transcriptional score in COPD and prioritized HBEGF as a key candidate associated with venous endothelial cell state changes and endothelial-smooth muscle communication. These findings suggest a potential JUN/HBEGF-associated endothelial signature relevant to COPD pulmonary vascular remodeling, which warrants further experimental validation.
abstract_zh: 背景：慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）是一种异质性呼吸系统疾病，涉及气道炎症、肺气肿和肺血管重塑。锰暴露与肺部炎症和氧化应激相关，但其与COPD血管病理的分子关联仍不清楚。本研究探讨了COPD中锰相关转录特征，并研究了其与内皮细胞功能障碍和血管重塑的潜在关系。方法：利用批量转录组数据集计算锰相关转录评分，鉴定差异表达基因，并表征WGCNA模块。通过交集锰相关基因、COPD差异表达基因和锰相关模块基因，获得锰-COPD相关基因。进行了功能富集、PPI分析、基于机器学习的特征选择、诊断建模和共识聚类。分析了单细胞RNA测序数据，以表征HBEGF表达、内皮细胞亚群、CytoTRACE2评分、伪时间动态、转录因子活性、细胞间通讯和NicheNet配体-靶标关系。结果：COPD样本显示显著更高的锰相关转录评分。共鉴定出43个锰-COPD相关候选基因，主要富集于炎症、细胞因子、免疫趋化和血管过程相关通路。机器学习识别出14个核心诊断基因，组合模型在训练和验证队列中表现出良好的分类性能。在这些基因中，HBEGF在ElasticNet模型中贡献最高，并被优先用于下游分析。共识聚类将COPD样本分为两个分子亚型，具有不同的锰相关评分和功能特征。单细胞分析提示HBEGF与内皮细胞改变密切相关，尤其是静脉内皮细胞。伪时间和转录因子分析提示潜在的JUN/HBEGF调控关系。CellChat和NicheNet分析进一步表明，静脉内皮细胞来源的HBEGF可能参与内皮-平滑肌细胞通讯。结论：本研究识别出COPD中升高的锰相关转录评分，并将HBEGF作为与静脉内皮细胞状态变化和内皮-平滑肌通讯相关的关键候选基因。这些发现提示与COPD肺血管重塑相关的潜在JUN/HBEGF相关内皮特征，有待进一步实验验证。
